title: 1st Sitting of Second session of 2026
summary: The first sitting of the second session of 2026 opened with 59 members present. The only business was electing a new Deputy Speaker, a post left empty after the previous holder resigned. A five-member temporary committee was approved to count the secret ballot, and Ahmed Saleem (Eydhafushi) won with 62 votes against 10 for Hussain Ziyad (Vaikaradhoo), with 2 invalid ballots.

Replaced an absent MDP nominee with Ibrahim Shujau.
Nominated Ahmed Saleem (Eydhafushi) for Deputy Speaker.

decisions: A temporary five-member committee to count the Deputy Speaker ballots was approved: Husnee Mubarik, Ibrahim Shujau, Dr. Anara Naeem, Ibrahim Nazil and Abdul Hannan Aboobakuru.
Ahmed Saleem (Eydhafushi) was elected Deputy Speaker of the 20th People's Majlis by secret ballot.
The next sitting was set for Monday 8 June 2026 at 9:00.

votes.what: Vote-counting committee for the Deputy Speaker election (93 members in total, 68 present)
Secret ballot for Deputy Speaker: Ahmed Saleem 62, Hussain Ziyad 10, 2 invalid ballots (72 valid votes)
